name: RoundTimer
brief: A round-based arena: a lobby floor with a SpawnLocation. The game loops forever: 5 seconds of intermission, then a 10 second round, then intermission again. A countdown value shows the seconds left.
contract: Create an IntValue named TimeLeft and a StringValue named Status inside script.Parent.
During intermission Status is "Intermission", during the round it is "Round". TimeLeft counts down once per second to 0 in both phases.
